stories.h: Driver in fatal Everett crash arrested again for DUI
stories.s: A 28-year-old convicted of vehicular homicide for a 2023 Everett Mall Way crash was arrested on suspicion of felony DUI in south Everett. He posted $15,000 bail and was released.

stories.h: Lynnwood weighs round-the-clock school zone speed cameras
stories.s: The Lynnwood council is considering running school-zone speed cameras 24/7 for safety and to help close a budget gap. It may take the proposal up again Wednesday; enforcement could begin in February.

stories.h: County health officials react to lost measles elimination status
stories.s: After the U.S. lost its measles elimination status, Snohomish County health leaders urged residents to check their MMR vaccination. The county had 14 cases earlier this year; Washington has 58.

stories.h: Mukilteo approves 2027-28 budget adding eight positions
stories.s: Mukilteo's council voted 5-1 for a budget that adds police, public works and other staff, raises the property tax and EMS levies by 1%, and puts off a surface water rate increase.

stories.h: EvCC breaks ground on $38 million Baker Hall
stories.s: Everett Community College broke ground on a 32,000-square-foot Baker Hall with a cosmetology wing and a 250-seat theater. It is expected to open in early 2028.

coming.h: Wintertide Sip & Shop in downtown Everett
coming.s: Downtown Everett holiday shopping evening, with wine and spirits at participating locations.

coming.h: Buddy Bowl anti-bullying game in Arlington
coming.s: Annual exhibition football fundraiser at John Larson Stadium honoring veterans and youth, with donations going to the Preston Dwoskin Scholarship Fund.
